one_liner: Senior UX researcher/designer at Treasury's Fiscal Service, shaping how agencies and states use the Do Not Pay payment-integrity tools and portals.
fit_summary: This GS-13 role requires a year at GS-12 level in user research, prototypes, journey maps and design artifacts. Daniel's resume has no UX or design work, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens or nationals) and to CTAP/ICTAP-eligible federal employees; no federal status needed.

You need one year of specialized experience equal to GS-12 covering all three areas: user research and insights, design artifacts such as prototypes and journey maps, and testing solutions with product and technical teams.
You must pass the USA Hire online assessment cut score and reach a score of 90 or higher to be referred.
You must pass a background investigation; no security clearance is required.
strategy: Skip this one: it requires a year at GS-12 level in user research, prototypes and journey maps, and his resume has no UX or design work.
Look for Treasury or other agency roles in stakeholder engagement or emergency management at GS-9/11, which fit his background better.
resume_bullets: Answered homeowners' questions about recovery program applications at a five-person ReBuild NC intake center (2019).
Answered employee travel-expense questions in Certify (2019–2024).
interview_questions: Walk us through a user research project you planned and led. How did your findings change the product?
How would you research the onboarding pain points of state agencies integrating with an API or portal?
How do you make sure a design meets Section 508 accessibility requirements?
Describe a time you had to persuade product owners or engineers to act on user insights they initially resisted.
watch_outs: This is a senior UX specialist role. Without documented UX research and design work, you'll likely be rated ineligible.
Hiring restrictions mean extra approvals may delay or block an offer even after you're selected.
The location is listed as 'Multiple Locations' and the job is not remote.
